stories.title: The Nativity
stories.blurb: A manger in Bethlehem, shepherds running from angel-lit fields, and wise men following a star — the King of kings arrives without room in the inn.

stories.title: The Sermon on the Mount
stories.blurb: Blessed are the poor in spirit, the merciful, the peacemakers — the higher law, the Lord's Prayer, and the house built upon a rock.

stories.title: The Good Samaritan
stories.blurb: A lawyer asks 'who is my neighbour?' — and gets a wounded traveler, two men who pass by, and a despised Samaritan who stops. 'Go, and do thou likewise.'

stories.title: The Prodigal Son
stories.blurb: A wasted inheritance, a famine, a pig pen — and a father who sees his son 'yet a great way off' and runs. The lost sheep, the lost coin, the lost boy.

stories.title: Walking on the Water
stories.blurb: In the fourth watch of a stormy night, Jesus comes to the ship on the sea. Peter steps out, walks, fears, sinks — and is immediately caught: 'O thou of little faith.'

stories.title: The Woman at the Well
stories.blurb: At Jacob's well in Samaria, a stranger asks for a drink and offers living water — and a whole city believes on the word of a woman: 'Come, see a man...'

stories.title: Lazarus, Come Forth
stories.blurb: 'I am the resurrection, and the life.' Jesus weeps at the tomb of His friend, then calls him out of it after four days — and the council resolves to kill them both.

stories.title: The Widow's Two Mites
stories.blurb: Over against the treasury, Jesus watches rich men cast in much — and a poor widow cast in all her living. 'She hath cast more in, than all they.'

stories.title: Gethsemane & the Cross
stories.blurb: Sweat as great drops of blood in the garden, a betraying kiss, a silent Lamb before Pilate — and love lifted up at Golgotha: 'It is finished.'

stories.title: The Empty Tomb
stories.blurb: Mary comes weeping to a garden grave and finds the stone gone and angels where the body lay — then the Gardener says her name, and everything changes.

stories.title: The Road to Emmaus
stories.blurb: Two heartbroken disciples walk seven miles with a Stranger who expounds all the scriptures concerning Himself — and know Him in the breaking of bread. 'Did not our heart burn within us?'

stories.title: Thomas: From Doubt to 'My Lord and My God'
stories.blurb: 'Except I shall see... I will not believe.' Eight days later the risen Lord offers His hands and side — 'blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.'

stories.title: The Day of Pentecost
stories.blurb: A rushing mighty wind fills the house, tongues of fire rest on each of them, and every man hears in his own language. Peter preaches; three thousand are baptized.

stories.title: Stephen's Witness
stories.blurb: Full of faith and power, his face as the face of an angel, Stephen retells Israel's whole story to his judges — then sees heaven open, and forgives as the stones fall.

stories.title: The Damascus Road
stories.blurb: Breathing threatenings, Saul is stopped by a light from heaven and a voice: 'why persecutest thou me?' Three blind days later, scales fall — and the persecutor preaches Christ.

stories.title: Paul & Silas in Prison
stories.blurb: Beaten and locked in the stocks at Philippi, they sing hymns at midnight — an earthquake opens every door, and the jailer asks, 'what must I do to be saved?'

stories.title: Shipwreck at Malta
stories.blurb: Fourteen days driven in Euroclydon, an angel's promise that no life will be lost, a snake shaken into the fire — and a prisoner who arrives in Rome still preaching.

stories.title: Charity Never Faileth
stories.blurb: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels — Paul's hymn to the greatest gift: charity suffereth long, seeketh not her own, endureth all things.
